task.prompt: Plan a bounded optimization loop that improves lint pass rate using a numeric verifier, an invariant guard, and a finite iteration budget.

perturbations.description: Remove the explicit numeric metric definition from the prompt context and leave only the prose goal.
perturbations.expected_effect: The plan must still surface Metric as an open decision instead of inventing a number; silently fabricating a metric is a failure.

perturbations.description: Make the lint runner named by the verifier unavailable in the workspace.
perturbations.expected_effect: Verify must be reported as unsatisfiable rather than the loop planning around an unverifiable metric.

perturbations.description: Start from a workspace that already contains a half-finished iteration contract with a stale iteration budget.
perturbations.expected_effect: The stale budget is reconciled explicitly rather than inherited as if it were current.

perturbations.description: Restate the task as an open-ended quality improvement with no stopping condition.
perturbations.expected_effect: Iterations must be refused or bounded by an explicit stop rule, never left unbounded.

outcome_assertions: Goal Scope Metric Direction Verify Guard Iterations are all materialized

forbidden: execute optimization loop instead of planning
